title: Entropy-Rate Selection for Partially Observed Processes
summary: I formulate an entropy-rate maximization problem at the observable level for stochastic processes observed through an information-reducing observation map. For a visible stationary law, the map determines an observational fiber of hidden stationary laws generating that law. In the finite-state finite-memory setting, retained visible constraints determine a feasible class of stationary $(r+1)$-block laws, and the entropy maximizer is defined as the entropy-rate maximizer on this class.
